Package in.co.rays.proj4.model

Class MarksheetModel

java.lang.Object
in.co.rays.proj4.model.MarksheetModel
public class MarksheetModel extends Object
MarksheetModel class handles all database operations related to Marksheet. It provides methods for CRUD operations, search with pagination, finding marksheet by roll number or primary key and getting merit list. This class interacts with ST_MARKSHEET table.

    • getMeritList

      public List<MarksheetBean> getMeritList(int pageNo, int pageSize) throws ApplicationException
      Returns merit list of students who have passed in all subjects. Students who have scored more than 33 marks in all subjects are included in the merit list ordered by total marks in descending order.
